name: Reconcile unsubscribed contacts with the Instantly block list

parameters.content:
## Instantly opt-out reconciliation
Connect one HTTP Header Auth credential to all four HTTP nodes. Header: Authorization. Value: your Bearer API key stored in Credentials.

Preview is the default. Both source lists exhaust cursors before planning. Set applyChanges true only after reviewing the preview. maxNewBlocks caps each run.

Only adds missing email blocks; never removes blocks or sends outreach. Existing domain blocks count as covered. Writes are individually read back. No automatic retry on ambiguous writes. See the guide.
